sam-cs: Quick coordination for SunriseCo dedicated bring-up tomorrow. Need owners for prime, autoscale tune, and post-run customer notes. Window 09:00-10:30 PT. Who can take 09-10?

mohit-ops: I can run 09-10. Will handle replayer and infra.

anya-se: Load profile request from Sunrise: steady at 70% reserved, short bursts (2x) at 2.5x for 90s each in first 45m. Mostly short chat turns.

leo-ml: Model is redwood-7b-4q, KV cache required. SLOs: p50 <120ms, p95 <380ms. If p95 >600ms for two sliding 5m windows, trigger fallback plan.

mohit-ops: Replayer (short): python replayer.py --acct sunrise --model redwood-7b-4q --qps 140 --burst-qps 350 --burst-dur 90 --out s3://redwood-load/sunrise/2025-02-04/

anya-se: Autoscale: min_instances=3, target_util=0.72, max_instances=16, cooldown=130s. Add +10% headroom during bursts.

iris-cs: I'll prep the renewal-risk note and a 1-slide enablement summary for the customer. Will collect post-run quality flags via a short form.

schedule-bot: Run reserved: sunrise-dedicated - 2025-02-04T16:00:00Z to 2025-02-04T17:30:00Z. Owner: mohit-ops.

mohit-ops: Starting warmup 09:00 PT, will post logs. Please watch for token throttles and cache hit ratio.

sam-cs: Thanks all 7; we'll reconvene here after run for retro and renewal-readout.
